paragraphs: In the complex process of papermaking production, there is an "invisible guardian" that always plays a key role quietly - it is the laboratory particle charge analyzer. From raw material processing to the birth of finished paper, it safeguards product quality, production efficiency and cost control by precisely controlling the charge balance of the wet-end system.
Papermaking production involves multiple key links, and the process is as follows:
Raw material processing: Wood, waste paper, etc. are used as the initial raw materials
Pulping process: Pulp is obtained through steps such as steaming or crushing, washing, and screening
The mesh dehydrates to form a wet paper sheet
干Drying removes the remaining moisture and finally forms the finished paper

Among them, the wet-end stage in the papermaking process is the core link connecting pulping and drying, involving the mixing and interaction of fibers, fillers, and various chemical auxiliaries in the aqueous phase, which directly determines the performance and production stability of the subsequent paper.
The essence of wet-end chemistry in papermaking is the charge interaction among fibers, fillers and additives in the aqueous phase.
Fibers and most fillers (such as calcium carbonate) usually carry a negative charge
Most of the various additives (such as cationic starch, cationic polyacrylamide, etc.) are positively charged substances
Charge balance is a prerequisite for the stability of wet-end systems, and its influence is mainly reflected in:

✅ When the positive and negative charges are properly matched: the retention rate of fibers and fillers is high, the water filtration efficiency is excellent, and the paper strength, uniformity and other properties are good
❌ When the positive charge is insufficient: Negative charge particles repel each other, resulting in a decrease in retention rate and causing waste of raw materials
❌ When the positive charge is excessive: the particles are overly coagulate, the water filtration speed decreases, the efficiency is affected, and the uniformity of the paper deteriorates

⚠️ Special risk: The accumulation of "anionic waste" (such as lignin, resin residues and other negatively charged colloidal substances) in the papermaking circulating water (white water) can disrupt the charge balance, leading to the failure of additives, production fluctuations and even paper breakage.
The laboratory particle charge analyzer precisely measures the surface charge characteristics of particles in the pulp system, including:
The demand for anions and cations

This quantifies the charge balance state within the system, providing scientific data for judging the interactions between particles (adsorption, coagulation, dispersion, etc.), and serves as the "data engine" for achieving precise control of wet-end chemistry.
1. Enhance the retention rate of fibers and fillers and reduce raw material consumption

By measuring the negative charge density of fibers and fillers in the pulp, the dosage of cationic additives can be precisely determined to ensure an appropriate match of positive and negative charges, thereby improving the utilization rate of raw materials and reducing waste.
2. Optimize the dosage of additives to enhance production efficiency
Strictly control the addition amount of cationic additives
Avoid cost increases and performance issues caused by overuse
To prevent the production effect from being affected by insufficiency, provide data basis for the optimization of the addition amount of additives, and achieve the maximization of benefits.
3. Monitor and control the anionic waste in white water to ensure stable production

Real-time monitoring of the negative charge density of white water enables timely grasp of the accumulation degree of "anionic waste", providing an accurate basis for adding anionic waste capture agents and avoiding serious problems such as production fluctuations and paper breakage.

The laboratory particle charge analyzer, through the precise quantification of the charge characteristics of the wet-end system, promotes the transformation of papermaking production from "experience-based" to "data-driven".
Its application in enhancing retention rate, optimizing the dosage of additives, and controlling anionic waste has effectively achieved:

As a key technical equipment for modern papermaking enterprises to achieve refined management and high-quality development, it is undoubtedly an indispensable "invisible guardian" in the papermaking process.

paragraphs: Driven by the dual forces of the digital economy and the "dual carbon" goals, liquid cooling technology is becoming a core breakthrough in fields such as precision electronics, data centers, new energy, and AI computing power. From July 30th to 31st, 2025, Bebur showcased its liquid cooling system cleanliness guardian - the particle counter at the 4th China Liquid Cooling Full Chain Supply Chain Summit, engaging in discussions with industry leaders, technical experts, and ecosystem partners on the heat dissipation revolution and empowering a green future!

As a world-leading provider of water quality and gas detection solutions, Bebur was honored to be invited to attend this conference. It systematically demonstrated the specific application and core value of particle counters in liquid cooling systems, contributing to the high-quality development of the industry. During the conference, the Bebur particulate matter counter attracted the attention of many participants and was highly regarded.

The liquid cooling system directly or indirectly removes heat through liquid circulation, but particulate contaminants in the liquid may cause blockage, corrosion, reduced heat dissipation efficiency, and even system failure. Therefore, the application of liquid particle counters in liquid cooling systems is particularly crucial, especially in scenarios with high power density and precise heat dissipation requirements.

The Bebur liquid particle counter can simultaneously monitor the particle size and corresponding quantity of 8 channels. paragraphs: With the widespread application of ozone in fields such as drinking water disinfection,wastewater treatment,industrial oxidation,and healthcare,the demand for accurate and reliable monitoring solutions is increasingly prominent.Whether it's leak detection to ensure personnel safety or concentration analysis to guarantee process efficiency,high-performance ozone monitoring equipment is indispensable.Bebur offers a comprehensive range of ozone monitoring products covering both gas and liquid phases,constructing complete solutions for various industries,from environmental safety to process optimization.

In locations where ozone is used,such as petrochemical plants,water treatment facilities,and laboratories,leaked ozone in the environment poses a direct threat to operator health and production safety.Bebur's AS525-O3 and AS300-O3 fixed online ozone leak detectors serve as the first line of defense in safeguarding the environment.
Both instruments utilize the electrochemical principle for continuous online monitoring of ozone concentrations in the air.They share the following key advantages:

Accuracy and Reliability:Built-in temperature compensation circuitry ensures measurement accuracy across a wide temperature range from-40°C to 70°C.With a repeatability of≤±2%and a T90 response time of less than 60 seconds,they provide rapid warnings.

Easy Maintenance:They support infrared remote calibration without the need to open the cover.The sensors feature plug-and-play functionality,greatly simplifying on-site maintenance and reducing downtime.
Robust and Durable:Featuring an IP66 enclosure rating and an Ex db IIC T6 Gb explosion-proof rating,they are suitable for the harshest industrial environments.
Easy Integration:Standard 4-20mA and RS485 output signals are provided,allowing easy integration into the user's DCS or PLC systems for centralized monitoring.

The AS525-O3 is an ideal choice for many industrial sites due to its high cost-performance ratio and excellent resistance to sulfides.The AS300-O3 comes standard with an audible and visual alarm and offers a wider range of measurement options to meet diverse customer requirements.Whether in municipal wastewater treatment plants or cleanrooms in biochemical and pharmaceutical industries,these devices stand guard 24/7,silently ensuring environmental safety.

In critical areas such as the outlet of an ozone generator or within pipelines,merely monitoring for leaks is insufficient for process control needs.These applications require specialized instruments capable of accurately analyzing high concentrations of ozone gas.Bebur's BT3500-OZ ozone gas analyzer is specifically designed for this purpose.

The BT3500-OZ ozone gas analyzer employs the UV dual-beam absorption method,strictly adhering to the Lambert-Beer law.It is specially designed for continuous online measurement of high-concentration ozone at the outlet of ozone generators or within pipelines.Its core advantages include:

High Precision and Stability:Utilizing a UV LED light source(wavelength 254nm)and separated optical cell technology,it offers high measurement accuracy and is resistant to pressure and high gas flow impacts.
Intelligent Zero Drift Management:An integrated automatic zero purge function(every 72 hours)effectively prevents zero drift,ensuring data reliability during long-term continuous operation.
User-Friendly:Equipped with a 5.0-inch touchscreen,the interface is intuitive,making it convenient for on-site personnel to view real-time data and perform settings.

This analyzer is widely used by ozone generator manufacturers,in municipal water treatment,fine chemical,and food&beverage industries.It is not only used to monitor the generator's output concentration to evaluate equipment performance but also in off-gas treatment processes to ensure efficient ozone utilization and compliance with emission standards.It is a core instrument for achieving precise control in ozone-based processes.

In the final stages of water treatment or during the process itself,the concentration of dissolved ozone in water is a key indicator for evaluating disinfection effectiveness and controlling the formation of by-products.To address this need,Bebur offers two water analyzers based on different principles,each with distinct strengths:the BT6308-OZ ozone water analyzer and the Full Spectrum ozone analyzer.

The BT6308-OZ ozone water analyzer utilizes the classic membrane-covered amperometric method.It is specifically designed for monitoring ozone disinfection in clean water applications such as drinking water,swimming pool water,and purified water for pharmaceutical use.Its characteristics include:
Stable Performance:Unaffected by pH variations or the presence of cleaning agents in the water.It requires no frequent zero calibration and can achieve a maintenance-free period of up to 12 months.

Accurate Measurement:The hydrophilic membrane and amperometric principle enable precise measurement and rapid response,making it an ideal choice for accurately controlling disinfectant dosage in water bodies.

For more complex matrices such as wastewater treatment or surface water monitoring,Bebur offers the Full Spectrum ozone analyzer.This sensor employs 200-800nm full spectrum measurement technology,offering revolutionary advantages:

Strong Anti-Interference Capability:By acquiring full-spectrum"optical fingerprint"information and using advanced algorithms,it automatically compensates for cross-interference from suspended solids or organic matter,making it particularly suitable for water with significant turbidity variations.

Wide Range and Maintenance-Free:Supports configurable optical path lengths from 1 to 150mm,with a measurement range covering 0-200mg/L.The sensor comes with a built-in automatic cleaning brush,greatly extending maintenance intervals.Its IP68 protection rating ensures long-term reliable operation in harsh environments.
Environmentally Friendly:As an in-situ optical measurement,it requires no chemical reagents and produces no secondary pollution.

From ppm-level leak warnings in ambient air,to precise analysis of high-concentration ozone in pipelines,and finally to stable monitoring of dissolved ozone in water,Bebur leverages a multi-technology platform combining electrochemical,UV absorption,and full spectrum methods.This provides users across municipal,industrial,pharmaceutical,and environmental sectors with"one-stop"ozone monitoring solutions.Centered on high precision,easy maintenance,and strong durability,these devices not only ensure production safety and personnel health but also empower enterprises to achieve precise control of ozone processes and continuously optimize operational efficiency.

As a professional brand in the field of water quality detection and gas detection,Bebur's UV Ozone Analyzer(BT3500-OZ Series)has been widely applied in the ozone generator industry,becoming an ideal choice to ensure the stable operation of equipment and optimize production control.

The Bebur BT3500-OZ UV ozone gas analyzer is specially designed for real-time detection of ozone concentration at the outlet of ozone generators.It can be installed on the outlet pipeline of the generator,featuring second-level response and continuous measurement of the concentration of produced ozone gas.Its core value is reflected in the following four aspects:

Adopting the UV dual-beam absorption method(254nm),it is not affected by gas flow rate and pressure fluctuations,and can stably output accurate data under the impact of high concentration and large flow.Operators can grasp the ozone concentration at any time through the display screen or upper computer,and adjust equipment parameters in a timely manner to ensure that the production concentration is always within the set range.

The BT3500-OZ is equipped with a gas flow meter,which accurately calculates the actual ozone output through the formula of"concentration×flow rate".This data can not only be used for factory calibration of generators,but also compare the theoretical output with the actual output during operation to judge whether the equipment efficiency has decreased,providing a basis for maintenance.

Abnormal fluctuations in ozone concentration often indicate problems such as discharge chamber faults,changes in gas source quality or pipeline leakage.The analyzer has a built-in alarm function;once the concentration exceeds the upper and lower limits,an alarm will be triggered immediately to remind operators to troubleshoot in a timely manner and avoid production interruption and secondary losses.

In addition to monitoring the gas in the pipeline,Bebur ozone analyzers can also be used for monitoring ozone leakage in the ambient air around the generator or in the tail gas,and link with tail gas destruction devices for harmless treatment to ensure that the workplace complies with occupational health and safety standards.

When the ozone produced by the ozone generator is injected into water for disinfection or oxidation treatment,the concentration of dissolved ozone in water needs to be precisely controlled-an excessively low concentration will lead to incomplete disinfection,while an excessively high concentration will cause waste and may produce by-products.

The Bebur BT6308-OZ ozone water quality analyzer is designed to solve this problem.It adopts electrochemical amperometry(membrane sensor)for continuous on-line monitoring of dissolved ozone concentration in water,and is commonly used in:advanced treatment of tap water and drinking water;ozone disinfection of swimming pool water;municipal sewage and industrial wastewater treatment;ozone disinfection of purified water/water for injection in the pharmaceutical industry,etc.

The Bebur BT6308-OZ ozone water quality analyzer has the advantages of no reagent required,no influence by pH value,and a maintenance cycle of up to 12 months.It is an ideal partner for the downstream applications of ozone generators,ensuring the controllability of the entire process from gas generation to water disinfection.

paragraphs: The residual chlorine detector is an important tool for water quality monitoring, widely used in areas such as drinking water treatment, swimming pool management, and industrial wastewater treatment, to monitor the concentration of residual disinfectants (such as chlorine) in water and ensure water safety.

Since 2025, global standards for drinking water safety and wastewater discharge have continued to become stricter. China has also updated and implemented more stringent standards for drinking water hygiene, and the market size of residual chlorine detectors has reached a significant scale. It is expected that from 2026 to 2030, its compound annual growth rate will remain at a high level.

Bebur is a professional provider of residual chlorine detection solutions, dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing and service of residual chlorine detection instruments. It has developed and launched a series of products for residual chlorine detection in municipal drinking water, municipal wastewater, industrial wastewater, and spa swimming pool disinfection, entering the Chinese market in 2008 and establishing a Chinese company - Bebur Technology limited in 2020, with sales headquarters and after-sales service bases set up in Beijing and Sichuan. Its BT6308-CL series uses membrane or non-membrane amperometric principle sensors for sample measurement; the BC350 series uses DPD colorimetric method for measurement.

Hach is a professional water quality and hydrological monitoring instrument technology enterprise. The company's goal is to continue to provide reliable instruments, complete prefabricated reagents, accurate and diverse testing methods, simple operation steps and high-quality customer service to its users, and continuously improve product quality to meet the changing needs of customers.

E+H is a professional brand in the field of process and laboratory measurement technology, providing a combination of field instruments, solutions and service products to help customers in the process industry optimize product quality and improve production efficiency.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is a scientific service enterprise registered in Delaware, USA and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. The company mainly provides analytical instruments, reagent consumables, software services, and laboratory solutions. Its products and services cover multiple scientific research fields such as life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, and materials science.

Schreimer is a multinational enterprise specializing in full-process technical services for water circulation. Its name originates from the name of the tissue in ancient Greek that transports water and nutrients. As a comprehensive service provider for water treatment equipment, its solutions cover all stages of the water treatment process, including pumping systems, disinfection equipment, and wastewater treatment processes.

In the field of drinking water safety, the "Standards for Drinking Water Quality" (GB 5749-2022) stipulates that the residual chlorine in the outlet water should be ≥ 0.3 mg/L, and the residual chlorine at the end of the pipe network should be ≥ 0.05 mg/L. The control of disinfection by-products has been included, and mandatory online monitoring has become a legal obligation.

Recommended selection: Hach (CL17sc) and Bebur (BC350), which comply with national standards and have high data stability. (The detection method stipulated by GB/T 5750.11-2023 is the DPD colorimetric method.)

The municipal water supply system is most afraid of "decrease in residual chlorine at the end of the pipe network". When the residual chlorine is insufficient, microorganisms are prone to exceed the standard. The 24-hour monitoring equipment for residual chlorine in the pipe network can monitor the residual chlorine at the end of the pipe network and联动 the secondary disinfection system to ensure that the residual chlorine at the end meets the standard.

Recommended selection： Bebur (BT6308-CL) and E+H (CCS51E)， with coated sensor， compared with the colorimetric measurement principle， the maintenance requirements are lower， and the usage cost is significantly reduced.

Medical institutions are most concerned about "insufficient disinfection of wastewater". The data from manual monitoring lacks legal validity, and they are prone to penalties during law enforcement checks. Real-time monitoring of residual chlorine in wastewater and linking it with the disinfection system to ensure compliance with discharge standards.
Recommended choices: Bebur Barbel and Thermo Fisher Scientific.

Food processing plants are very strict about residual chlorine control. If the residual chlorine in the production water is insufficient, the microbial content will exceed the standard; if the residual chlorine exceeds the limit, it will also affect the taste of the products. Therefore, precise measurement is required.
Recommended choices: Bebur Barbel BT6308-CL (online type) and Thermo Fisher Scientific AQ3170 (portable).

In conclusion, Bebur has provided reliable and cost-effective solutions for most municipal and industrial water treatment scenarios through its complete electrochemical and colorimetric product line, performance indicators that meet mainstream application requirements, and extensive practical experience in the Chinese market.

For the purchasing party, when making a selection, they should comprehensively consider the application scenario, precision requirements, maintenance capabilities, budget constraints, and service response speed. They should choose products with matching parameters and complete services to achieve a balanced optimization of water quality safety, operational costs, and compliance risks.

paragraphs: An ozone detector is an instrument used for real-time monitoring of ozone concentration in air or water, and is widely applied in environmental monitoring, air purification, water treatment, laboratory analysis, and other fields.

Meanwhile, stricter industrial safety regulations and growing demand for integrated VOCs management are driving ozone detectors into a new phase characterized by dual drivers: policy-driven adoption and technological innovation. When selecting ozone detectors, manufacturers must evaluate not only detection accuracy, stability, and reliability but also comprehensively assess suppliers' technical expertise, service networks, and lifecycle costs. Among industry players, Bebur has emerged as a standout brand, leveraging its technical expertise in UV absorption methods and electrochemical principles, coupled with successful implementations across municipal water treatment, chemical processing, pharmaceuticals, and food & beverage sectors.
Ozone gas detectors are primarily used for monitoring ozone concentration in the air, playing a critical role in industrial safety, environmental monitoring, and leak detection applications.

This is currently the most widely adopted method, recognized as the standard protocol by numerous countries. It utilizes the characteristic absorption properties of ozone molecules at 254 nm ultraviolet wavelengths to calculate concentrations based on light attenuation after sample passage. The method demonstrates high precision and stability, being unaffected by other gases, though associated with relatively high equipment costs. The Bebur BT3500-OZ device employs this principle and finds extensive applications across industries including ozone generator manufacturers, municipal water treatment, industrial wastewater processing, fine chemical production, food processing, space disinfection, swimming pool sterilization, and fragrance synthesis processes utilizing ozone generators.

The sensor generates an electrical signal proportional to ozone concentration through redox reactions occurring at its internal electrodes. This technology, characterized by compact size, low power consumption, rapid response, and cost-effectiveness, has become a standard solution for portable and stationary ozone detectors. However, the sensors have limited operational lifespan and may be susceptible to interference from other gases. Companies such as Bebur's AS525-O3, AS300-O3, and BT525-O3 utilize this principle, with widespread applications across industries including petroleum, chemical processing, metallurgy, refining, environmental protection, paper manufacturing, municipal services, biomedical applications, and water treatment systems.

The water ozone detector is used to monitor the concentration of ozone dissolved in water, which is crucial in industries such as water treatment, beverage production, and pharmaceutical manufacturing to ensure disinfection and oxidation efficacy.

This represents the mainstream technology for online ozone monitoring in water systems. The sensor consists of a selective permeable membrane, electrodes, and electrolyte. Ozone permeates the membrane and reacts at the electrodes to generate an electric current, with the current magnitude directly proportional to ozone concentration. This method offers excellent real-time performance, high selectivity, and is unaffected by water sample color or turbidity. The Bebur BT6308-OZ water ozone detector employs electrochemical technology integrated with a high-precision controller, supporting 4-20mA analog output and RS485 digital communication, enabling seamless integration with industrial DCS systems.

Similar to gas detection, this method utilizes ozone's absorption characteristics for 254 nm ultraviolet light. It offers high precision and minimal maintenance requirements, though the equipment requires significant investment, and factors such as water sample turbidity may interfere with measurements. The Bebur BT6308-UV-OZ employs this principle, enabling ozone monitoring at the ppb level.

Crowcon does not offer instruments for ozone detection in water.

paragraphs: According to QYResearch's 2026 market report, the global liquid particle counter market achieved sales of $978 million in 2025 and is projected to reach $1.24 billion by 2032, with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 3.5% (2026-2032).

Liquid particle counters are essential precision testing equipment for modern industrial quality control, widely applied in high-tech sectors such as electronics, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, and automotive manufacturing. According to QYResearch's 2026 market report, the global liquid particle counter market reached $978 million in sales in 2025 and is projected to reach $1.24 billion by 2032, with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 3.5% (2026-2032). This robust growth trend stems from increasingly stringent cleanliness control requirements in global manufacturing, as well as the urgent demand for ultrafine particle detection capabilities in emerging industries like semiconductors and biopharmaceuticals.

Thanks to the continuous improvement of drug quality control requirements in the pharmaceutical industry, China's manufacturing sector is transitioning towards high-end and intelligent development, with surging demand for precision testing equipment. The implementation of the "Made in China 2025" strategy has provided strong policy support for high-end equipment manufacturing, and the Chinese market has demonstrated remarkable growth potential. According to industry research data, by 2030, the market size of China's liquid particle counters is expected to exceed 20.53 billion yuan.

Particle Measuring Systems (PMS) is a clean environment and pollution monitoring technology company specializing in providing high-precision liquid particle counting solutions for industries such as semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, and microelectronics. Its liquid particle counter product line features a comprehensive range of particle sizes spanning from 20nm to 125μm, utilizing light scattering detection technology to meet stringent requirements across diverse application scenarios.

Bebur originated from the UK and is a representative brand of professional liquid particle counters. The brand entered the China market in 2008, and after more than a decade of dedicated development, its product quality has been recognized by a wide range of Chinese users. In 2020, Bebur established a China company—Bebur Special Instruments Co., Ltd.—to provide Chinese users with more convenient and efficient professional technical communication and services.

In addition to liquid particle counters, the Bebur product line also includes water quality analyzers, gas detectors, flow meters, level gauges, and coagulant dosing control equipment, dedicated to providing customers with advanced water quality testing and gas detection solutions.

Bebur offers two major product series: online and portable models. Its BT8200/8500 online liquid particle counter employs the photoresistance principle, supporting 24-hour continuous monitoring of particle size, quantity, and changes in liquids. The detection range covers 1-200μm, 2-400μm, and 2-750μm.

The portable product BTP8300 is suitable for field and on-site operations, featuring advantages such as rapid detection speed, strong interference resistance, and high precision. It offers a wide measurement range, with the standard version covering 1μm to 400μm and the customized version extending to 2μm to 750μm. Users can configure up to 32 measurement channels.

Rion is a Japanese precision measurement instrument manufacturer specializing in acoustic, vibration, and particle measurement technologies. Its liquid particle counters are widely used in high-end industrial sectors such as semiconductors, microelectronics, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, and ultrapure water production. Utilizing light scattering technology, Rion's liquid particle counters provide measurement solutions across particle size ranges from 0.02μm to 125μm, meeting stringent liquid purity requirements across various industries.

Lighthouse Worldwide Solutions, a U.S.-based provider specializing in real-time pollution monitoring, offers a comprehensive range of liquid particle counters widely used in industries with stringent cleanliness requirements such as pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and aerospace. Beyond liquid particle counters, its product portfolio includes air particle counters, microbial samplers, temperature/humidity sensors, and facility monitoring systems, delivering end-to-end solutions that span particle counting to environmental parameter monitoring.

Beckman Coulter is a manufacturer of life science and industrial testing instruments, with its liquid particle counters playing a pivotal role in the pharmaceutical industry. The Beckman Coulter liquid particle counters provide measurement solutions across the full particle size range from 0.2μm to 600μm, complemented by the Multisizer series based on the resistance method principle, capable of measuring particles up to 1600μm in size. These solutions meet stringent requirements for liquid purity and particle characterization across various industries.
Liquid particle counters primarily operate on three detection principles:

This is currently the mainstream and widely applied technology. The Bebur BT8200, BT8500, and BTP8300 all employ this principle. The working mechanism involves a laser beam passing through a narrow sample flow cell. When particles in the liquid flow past the laser beam, they partially block the light, causing an instantaneous reduction in the light intensity detected by the sensor. The extent of this reduction is directly proportional to the projected area of the particles (i.e., particle size).

The PMS system from the United States and Rion products from Japan operate on this principle. When particle size is smaller than the wavelength of light, the energy scattered by light is significantly stronger than that reflected or refracted. The intensity of scattered light exhibits a consistent relationship with particle size, the refractive index of the particle-medium interface, and the light wavelength. Therefore, particle size can be determined by measuring scattered light intensity. This technique is particularly suitable for detecting ultrafine particles (e.g., at the 0.02μm level).

The Beckman Coulter Multisizer 4e operates on this principle. Particles pass through a small aperture with the electrolyte, causing an instantaneous increase in resistance across the aperture and generating a voltage pulse. The pulse magnitude is proportional to the particle volume. The advantage of this technique lies in its independence from the particle refractive index, color, or composition.

As semiconductor technologies evolve toward 7nm, 5nm, and even more advanced nodes, the demand for particle detection accuracy continues to rise.

The pharmaceutical industry is another important application field for liquid particle counters. According to standards such as the China Pharmacopoeia, USP (United States Pharmacopeia), and EP (European Pharmacopoeia), insoluble particles must be detected during drug production to ensure drug safety. Industry data shows that the demand for liquid particle counting systems in the pharmaceutical industry accounted for approximately 35% in 2024, and this proportion is expected to rise to 42% by 2030.

In industries such as aerospace, automotive manufacturing, and construction machinery, cleanliness monitoring of hydraulic oils and lubricants serves as a core tool for equipment condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Liquid particle counters from brands like Bebur are widely used in scenarios including hydraulic filter element cleanliness testing and liquid-cooled plate cleanliness evaluation. According to international standards (e.g., ISO 4406, NAS 1638, GJB 420A/B), liquid cleanliness grade assessment requires precise particle count data. These particle counters determine system compliance with cleanliness standards by quantitatively analyzing solid particle contaminants in filter flushing fluids or system oils.

With the rapid development of new energy vehicles, data centers, and high-performance computing equipment, liquid cooling plates, as key components for efficient heat dissipation, have seen a surge in demand for cleanliness inspection of their internal flow channels. During the manufacturing, welding, and assembly processes of liquid cooling plates, micro-particle contaminants such as metal shavings, welding slag, and dust are inevitably generated.
The Bebur liquid particle counter demonstrates significant advantages in cleanliness detection for liquid-cooled plates:
High precision and repeatability: Capable of accurately measuring particles at the micron level with stable results across multiple tests.
High efficiency: Compared to traditional microscopic analysis methods, the liquid automatic particle counter can complete multi-channel analysis of a sample in a short time.
Objectivity: Avoids the subjective errors associated with manual visual counting.
When selecting a liquid particle counter, the following technical parameters should be prioritized:
Select appropriate detection accuracy based on application requirements:
Ultrafine particle detection (for semiconductors and ultrapure water): Options include Japan's Rion, USA's PMS, and USA's Lighthouse.

The multi-channel design enables simultaneous monitoring of particles across different size ranges, thereby enhancing detection efficiency. Bebur provides standard 8 particle size detection channels, with support for up to 32 measurement channels (customizable up to 1000 channels).
Select appropriate flow rate based on detection scenarios:

Based on the specified selection parameters and budget considerations:

Given calibration and maintenance costs, prioritize products that support on-site calibration (e.g., Bebur's software-guided high-precision on-site calibration function).
Consider spare parts supply and technical support response speed

In summary, as a core tool for modern industrial quality control and predictive maintenance, liquid particle counters have broad market prospects and rapid technological development. In the global market, Particle Measuring Systems holds the largest market share, followed closely by Rion and Lighthouse Worldwide Solutions. For China users, Bebur is a key consideration due to its localized advantages of entering China in 2008 and establishing a China company in 2020, as well as its outstanding performance in fields such as hydraulic monitoring and liquid cooling detection.

When selecting a liquid particle counter, comprehensive consideration should be given to factors such as specific application scenarios, detection accuracy requirements, budget, and service support. The company aims to continue providing users with reliable instruments, comprehensive pre-prepared reagents, accurate and diverse testing methods, simple operational procedures, and high-quality customer service, while continuously improving product quality to meet the ever-changing needs of clients.

E+H is a leading brand in process and laboratory measurement technologies, offering a comprehensive portfolio of field instruments, solutions, and services to help process industry clients optimize product quality and enhance production efficiency.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is a science services company registered in Delaware, USA, with its headquarters located in Waltham, Massachusetts. The company primarily provides analytical instruments, reagents and consumables, software services, and laboratory solutions, with products and services spanning multiple scientific research fields including life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, and materials science.

Xylem (China) Co., Ltd. is a multinational enterprise specializing in full-process technical services for water circulation. Its name originates from the ancient Greek term for the plant tissues that transport water and nutrients. As a comprehensive service provider of water treatment equipment, its solutions cover the entire lifecycle, including pumping systems, disinfection equipment, and wastewater treatment processes.

In the field of drinking water safety, the Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water (GB 5749-2022) explicitly stipulates that residual chlorine levels must be ≥0.3 mg/L at water treatment plants and ≥0.05 mg/L at the end of the distribution network, and incorporates requirements for disinfection byproduct control. Mandatory online monitoring has become a legal obligation.

Recommended choices: Hach CL17sc and Bebur BC350, which comply with national standards and exhibit high data stability. (The testing method specified in GB/T 5750.11-2023 is the DPD colorimetric method.)

Municipal water utilities are most concerned about "chlorine residual decay at pipeline terminals." Insufficient residual chlorine levels can easily lead to microbial overgrowth. Pipeline residual chlorine monitoring equipment performs 24-hour surveillance of residual chlorine concentrations in the network, which is then integrated with secondary disinfection systems to ensure terminal residual chlorine levels meet regulatory standards.

Recommended models: Bebur BT6308-CL and E+H CCS51E, both featuring film-coated sensors. Compared to colorimetric measurement principles, these sensors require lower maintenance and significantly reduce operational costs.

Medical institutions are most concerned about "substandard sewage disinfection," as manual monitoring data lacks legal validity and is prone to penalties during enforcement inspections. Real-time monitoring of residual chlorine in sewage and integrated disinfection systems ensure compliance with discharge standards.

Food processing plants are highly stringent in residual chlorine control. Insufficient residual chlorine in production water leads to microbial overgrowth, while excessive residual chlorine can adversely affect product taste. Therefore, precise measurement is essential.
Recommended options: Bebur BT6308-CL (online type) and Thermo Fisher AQ3170 (portable type).

In conclusion, Bebur has provided reliable and cost-effective solutions for most municipal and industrial water treatment scenarios with its complete electrochemical and colorimetric product line, performance indicators meeting mainstream application requirements, and extensive practice in the China market.

For purchasers, the selection process should comprehensively consider application scenarios, precision requirements, maintenance capabilities, budget constraints, and service response speed to choose products with parameter compatibility and comprehensive services, thereby achieving optimal balance between water quality safety, operational costs, and compliance risks.

Brand Introduction:Bebur specializes in the R&D,manufacturing,and service of online total organic carbon(TOC)analyzers.Our products have earned widespread recognition and acclaim for their mature designs,precision craftsmanship,and professional on-site solutions.Utilizing ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy technology,these instruments operate without chemical reagents and feature turbidity compensation with self-cleaning capabilities to enhance measurement accuracy.They are extensively applied in water treatment facilities,wastewater treatment plants,river basins,surface and groundwater monitoring systems,as well as industrial water treatment applications.

Core advantages:Specialized in optical technology(based on UV spectral absorption principle),delivering superior performance,comprehensive localized services,rapid after-sales response,high cost-effectiveness,no consumables required,and low maintenance costs,demonstrating outstanding performance in industrial process control.

Brand Introduction:Hach has extensive expertise in water quality analysis.The instruments employ oxidation technologies including Total Suspended Organic Matter Oxidation(TSAO),as well as UV-peroxosulfate and hydroxyl radical oxidation methods(available with optional oxygen generators).

paragraphs: The online residual chlorine analyzer is a high-precision instrument used for detecting residual chlorine content in water samples, widely applied in various fields requiring disinfection and water quality control. This article recommends five online residual chlorine analyzer brands from three perspectives: characteristics, international standards, and domestic production, to assist you in quickly identifying suitable products.

Bebur is a professional water quality analysis instrument brand originating from the UK, which entered the China market in 2008 and established a China company (Bebert Instrument Co., Ltd.) in 2020 to provide localized services. The brand's residual chlorine analyzers are characterized by two major technical approaches: the electrode method (model: BT6308-CL) and DPD colorimetry (model: BC350), demonstrating outstanding performance in municipal water supply, wastewater treatment, and industrial process water applications. Its overall positioning lies between international high-end brands and domestic mainstream brands, with significant cost-performance advantages.

Bebur is a professional and reliable brand in the field of residual chlorine analyzers, particularly suitable for users seeking international quality + localized services + high cost-performance ratio. Its membrane amperometric technology demonstrates significant advantages in maintenance-free operation and stability, with a 6-month maintenance-free period that stands out among similar products.

As a global leader in water quality analysis, HACH provides multi-scenario compatible solutions with authoritative data and comprehensive domestic technical support. Its CL17sc/CL17Dsc Total Chlorine and Residual Chlorine Online Analyzer represents the next-generation intelligent water quality monitoring equipment developed by HACH. Based on established colorimetric principles, this system utilizes advanced automatic compensation and diagnostic technologies to achieve precise and reliable monitoring of residual chlorine/total chlorine levels. Featuring exceptional interference resistance and user-friendly maintenance design, the instrument is widely applicable for water quality control in industries such as drinking water safety disinfection, wastewater treatment, and food and beverage processing.

As a global leader in process automation, E+H is renowned for its digital sensing technology, high integration capabilities, and robust interference resistance in residual chlorine monitoring systems. The company's sensor designs prioritize durability and long-term stability, ensuring reliable continuous operation in industrial environments. E+H's core advantage lies in seamlessly integrating residual chlorine measurement into comprehensive water treatment process monitoring solutions (such as pH, turbidity, and flow rate data), enabling unified management and diagnostics within a single system platform. For large-scale industrial water treatment projects already equipped with E+H instrumentation systems, residual chlorine analyzers offer seamless integration and streamlined data management capabilities.

Lu Heng Environemnt specializes in cost-effective residual chlorine monitoring equipment that integrates both DPD colorimetric and electrode methods, offering product lines spanning portable and online models. The instruments feature affordable pricing, intuitive operation, low consumable reagent costs, and require no professional maintenance, making them ideal for basic applications such as swimming pools, small-scale water treatment plants in rural areas, residential secondary water supply systems, and simple on-site testing. Their advantages include low cost, ease of operation, and convenient after-sales support, effectively meeting routine residual chlorine control needs for disinfection processes. However, the products prioritize cost-effective consumer-oriented designs, demonstrating average performance in high precision, pollution resistance, and long-term industrial stability. They are particularly suitable for non-professional monitoring scenarios with limited budgets and simple operational conditions.

Createc is a veteran industrial-grade water quality analysis brand. Its residual chlorine analyzers leverage mature electrode-based technology as their core advantage, featuring high precision, anti-pollution resistance, corrosion resistance, long-lasting membrane components, and robust long-term operational reliability. The products are compatible with complex industrial environments including power generation, petrochemical circulating water systems, municipal water supply networks, and industrial wastewater treatment facilities. Supporting multi-parameter integration and remote communication capabilities, they can be seamlessly integrated into automated control systems, with professional performance ranking among top domestic brands. While priced higher than consumer-grade models and requiring specialized maintenance expertise, these instruments excel in industrial and municipal applications demanding data stability, operational adaptability, and long-term unattended operation. Their comprehensive performance closely aligns with industrial-grade application standards.

When selecting residual chlorine analyzers, users should conduct comprehensive evaluations based on specific application scenarios, considering multiple dimensions such as measurement accuracy, response time, maintenance costs, environmental adaptability, and data transmission capabilities, to choose the most cost-effective product.

Based on the principle of membrane amperometry, the free chlorine water quality analyzer can quickly analyzer the concentration of dissolved free chlorine in water on site.

The residual chlorine (HCLO and CLO-) in water enters the sensor through the hydrophobic membrane of the residual chlorine sensor. The pH value of the residual chlorine electrolyte inside is approximately 6. Under this environment, the incoming hypochlorite ions (CLO-) will be converted into hypochlorous acid (HCLO) and diffuse to move to the working electrode for consumption. The electrode generates a current signal corresponding to the partial pressure of dissolved residual chlorine. The signal is amplified by the signal amplifier and rectified into a DC signal for output.
After the controller of the residual chlorine analyzer reads the current signal detected by the sensor, it will convert the signal value and display the detection value intuitively.

While measuring the residual chlorine concentration, the temperature of the sample water is also detected simultaneously. The output signal of the sensor is compensated through an electronic device, so that the measured value can be corrected as the temperature changes.
Due to the dual effects of the sensor's design structure and the electrolyte, the residual chlorine sensor is not affected by the pH value of the water during operation.

When the residual chlorine concentration in water changes, the detection values collected by the residual chlorine analyzer will also change accordingly. In this way, real-time and reliable detection basis can be provided for the disinfection effect of the sample water.

The SCM530 fStreaming Current Detectors drives the piston to reciprocate in the sensor cylinder through an electric motor, maintaining the continuous flow of the water sample. The piston of the sensor moves up and down reciprocally within the annular electrode. When the water sample with coagulant added passes through the online swimming current meter sensor, The water in the annular space of the electrodes also moves accordingly. The double electric layer of the colloidal particles is disturbed, and the water flow carries the counterions in the colloidal diffusion layer to move together, thereby forming a flow current. This flow current is collected by the electrodes at both ends, amplified by the signal amplifier, and rectified into a direct current signal for output. When the concentration of colloidal particles in water changes, the detection values collected by the SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors will also change accordingly. In this way, real-time and reliable detection basis can be provided for the coagulation effect of the raw water.

After the controller reads the flow current value detected by the sensor, it will convert the flow current value and display the detection value intuitively. The controller is equipped with PID control function. After comparing and calculating the flow current value with the set reference value, it will output a 4-20mA signal for adjusting the opening degree of the metering pump or dosing valve.

The SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors can be optionally equipped with a self-cleaning function. According to the set cleaning time, the sensor of the flow current meter can be flushed at regular intervals, which can enhance the adaptability of the SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors to poor water quality conditions.

The ozone sensor, based on the principle of electrochemical amperometry, can rapidly analyze dissolved ozone in water on-site. Ozone diffuses into the sensor through the hydrophilic membrane, first undergoing a chemical reaction with the electrolyte solution to form an electrochemically active compound, and then moves to the working electrode through diffusion. At the working electrode, the active compound is oxidized, generating a current signal corresponding to the partial pressure of dissolved malodorous oxygen for quantitative analysis. While measuring the ozone concentration, it is also necessary to detect the temperature of the sample water and compensate for the output signal of the sensor through an electronic device, so that the measured value can be corrected as the temperature changes (temperature compensation).

The electromagnetic flowmeter functions based on Faraday law of electromagnetic induction,which states that a conductor moving in a magnetic field will generate induced voltage.
Liquid can be regarded as conductor,and the magnetic field is generated by the energized coil outside the flow pipe.

The induced voltage amplitude is directly proportional to the velocity of motion of the conductor and the type of conductor,the diameter of the pipe,and the strength of the magnetic field,which is given by: E=B-V-D-K
V-Velocity of movement of the conducting fluid;
K-Coefficient related to magnetic field distribution and axiallength(instrument coefficient); B,D,and K can either be fixed or calibrated,so that the equation is simplified as E∝V.

The sensor transmits the induced potential E as a flow signal to the converter.Upon signal processing such as amplification,transformation,and filtering,the instantaneous flow and accumulated flow are displayed by a dot-matrix LCD with backlight.

headings: I. Monitoring scenes and target objects
Ii. Detection Technology and Equipment Selection
Part Two: Water Quality Testing Solutions
paragraphs: The chemical industry,due to its complex processes,diverse materials and high potential risks,has extremely strict requirements for environmental and safety monitoring.
The gas risks in the chemical industry are mainly classified into three categories:flammable gases,toxic gases,and oxygen concentration.
Target substances: raw materials, intermediates, product vapors. For example: benzene series substances, chlorine, ammonia, hydrogen sulfide, VOCs (volatile organic compounds).
Target: Steam for storing materials. For example: benzene, toluene, xylene, propylene, liquefied petroleum gas, etc.
Key points: Leakage monitoring and regional safety protection.
Target substances: hydrogen sulfide, ammonia, methane, VOCs.
Key points: Safety of workers and monitoring of fugitive emissions.
Target substances: Various experimental gases and solvent vapors.
Key points: Environmental safety and personnel health.
Target substances: Characteristic pollutants (such as VOCs, malodorous gases).
Key point: Environmental compliance to prevent any impact on the surrounding communities.
Catalytic combustion (LEL) : Used for combustible gases.
Electrochemistry (EC) : It is used for toxic gases (H₂S,CO,Cl₂,NH₃, etc.) and has high sensitivity.
Infrared (IR) : Used for VOCs and hydrocarbons, it is anti-toxic, has a long service life, and is suitable for oxygen-deficient environments.
Photoionization (PID) : It is used for wide-range detection of VOCs, especially suitable for low-concentration leakage.
Deployment: Install sensors at key risk points and connect the data to the central control system.
Usage: Inspection, entry into confined Spaces, emergency response, and leakage point investigation.
Chemical water quality monitoring covers the entire process from influent, process, wastewater treatment to discharge.
Indicators: pH, turbidity, residual chlorine, conductivity.
Objective: To ensure that the quality of water sources meets production requirements.
Indicators: Related to specific processes, such as the concentration of specific ions (Cl⁻,F⁻,Na⁺), organic matter content (COD/TOC), pH, temperature, etc.
Objective: To monitor reaction efficiency and ensure product quality.
Indicators: Electrical conductivity, pH, dissolved oxygen, hardness.
Objective: To prevent scaling, corrosion and microbial growth, and ensure the safe operation of equipment.
Biochemical treatment unit (A/O tank) : DO (Dissolved Oxygen), MLSS (Suspended solids in mixed liquid), ORP (Oxidation-reduction potential), temperature, ammonia nitrogen, nitrate nitrogen.
Conventional indicators: pH, chemical oxygen demand (COD), ammonia nitrogen (NH₃-N), total nitrogen (TN), total phosphorus (TP), suspended solids (SS), flow rate.
Necessity: Achieving 24/7 continuous monitoring is a standard feature of modern chemical water management.
pH/ORP/ conductivity/dissolved oxygen analyzer: Fundamental and crucial.
COD online analyzer: Ultraviolet (UV) method is used for rapid early warning, and chemical method (potassium dichromate) is used for precise measurement and compliance.
TOC (Total Organic Carbon) analyzer: Rapidly reflects the degree of organic pollution in water bodies.
Specific ion online analyzers: such as fluoride ion, chloride ion analyzers, etc.

paragraphs: Inside high-heat-generating"big hearts"such as data centers and energy storage power stations,liquid cooling technology is becoming the absolute main force for heat dissipation.In this precise system,there is a key component that acts like a"heat transfer station",and its condition directly determines the efficiency and safety of the entire system-it is the plate heat exchanger.

Imagine that the liquid cooling system is filled with expensive,high-purity coolant flowing inside,which comes into direct contact with"delicate"chips such as the CPU and GPU and must remain absolutely clean.While external cooling towers or urban tap water,although low in cost,are bound to contain impurities,minerals and microorganisms.
How can the internal liquid transfer heat to the external liquid without allowing them to"mix together"?
At this point,it's the turn of the plate heat exchanger to make a brilliant appearance!

Plate heat exchangers are composed of a large number of thin plates made of stainless steel and other metals,with complex corrugated flow channels engraved on the plates.Cold and hot liquids flow in opposite directions in the adjacent plate channels.Heat can easily pass through the thin plates and be transferred from the hot side to the cold side.
Its core mission:isolation and heat transfer
Primary side(internal circulation):It flows with clean coolant inside and is responsible for removing the heat from the equipment.
Secondary side(external circulation):It flows with external cooling water,which is responsible for ultimately removing the heat.

The plate heat exchanger acts like a dedicated"goalkeeper",allowing the two liquids to only undergo"heat transfer through the air",physically completely isolated,thereby perfectly protecting the internal precision equipment and the clean liquid cooling circuit.
The four major advantages of plate heat exchangers

High efficiency and compact:The corrugated design generates turbulence,achieving extremely high heat transfer efficiency while maintaining a very small volume,making it highly suitable for scenarios with limited space.
Safety isolation:Preventing external dirty water from contaminating the internal system is the cornerstone of system reliability.
Precise temperature control:By adjusting the external water volume,the temperature of the coolant supplied to the equipment can be precisely controlled.
Easy maintenance:It can be easily opened for cleaning and maintenance.

If the plate heat exchanger is the"goalkeeper",then cleanliness is the bottom line that this goalkeeper must adhere to.Any tiny oil stain,metal shavings or particles could be an"invisible bomb"within the system,causing:
Decreased heat exchange efficiency:Dirt acts like a"cotton-padded jacket",enveloping the plates and hindering heat transfer,causing the equipment temperature to rise.
Flow channel blockage:Accumulation of particulate matter increases water flow resistance,raises the load on the water pump,and may even cause complete blockage.
Corrosion and leakage:Contaminants can accelerate system corrosion,eventually leading to leakage and causing disastrous consequences.
Therefore,cleanliness testing must run through the entire"life"of the plate heat exchanger.
A comprehensive physical examination of new equipment before it is put into use

A brand-new heat exchanger may carry"primary contamination"such as processing oil stains and metal shavings when it leaves the factory.Before accessing the system,one must go through a strict"purification ceremony".
Build an independent circulation loop and use high-flow deionized water for"violent flushing".

At the exit,a liquid particle counter is used for real-time monitoring.Only when the number of particles stably drops below the standard(such as the ISO cleanliness grade)can it be considered qualified.
The membrane filtration sampling method can also be adopted.After filtering the water sample,it is weighed and observed under a microscope to quantify the degree of cleanliness.
2."Regular physical examinations"and health care during operation

Even if it is very clean at the beginning,during long-term operation,the secondary side is prone to scale formation and the growth of bacteria and algae.It is necessary to monitor their"health indicators"regularly.

Taking body temperature:Under a fixed flow rate,if the temperature difference between the inlet and outlet becomes smaller,it indicates that it is"feverish"and the heat transfer efficiency has declined.
Blood pressure measurement:If the pressure drop passing through it increases,it indicates that the blood vessel(flow channel)may be blocked.
Regular"intestinal cleansing":Depending on the operation status,disassemble it regularly and give it a thorough"bath"with a brush,high-pressure water gun or chemical cleaning agent.
Water quality testing:Regularly test the cooling water on the secondary side to monitor its hardness,pH value,conductivity,etc.,to prevent scaling and corrosion from the source.

In today's pursuit of high computing power and high density,the significance of liquid cooling systems is self-evident.The plate heat exchanger,as its core heat exchange component,and cleanliness,as its lifeline,together form a solid guarantee for the stable operation of the system.
Suggestions for operation and maintenance engineers

Establish a strict cleanliness control system,from the"first line of defense"of new equipment acceptance to regular monitoring and maintenance during operation,to form a closed-loop management.Never lose the big picture for small gains.Let a tiny contaminant ruin the entire expensive liquid cooling system.

paragraphs: In the era of explosive computing power,liquid cooling technology has become the absolute leading role in heat dissipation for high-density data centers.When we talk about liquid cooling,we always focus on the coolant and the cold plate.However,there is one core component that is crucial but often overlooked-it is the Manifold.

If coolant is the"blood"of a data center,then Manifold is the precisely designed"heart"and"vascular network".Its performance and cleanliness directly determine the survival of the entire liquid cooling system.
In simple terms,Manifold is a multi-path connector,but it is far more than just a connector.Its core mission is:precise allocation and efficient aggregation.

Precise"flow scheduler":In a server filled with Gpus and cpus,Manifold is responsible for evenly distributing the total coolant flow from the water pump to the cold plates of each heat-generating element.Imagine if there were a"diversion",with some chips"drinking their fill"of coolant while others"thirsty",the inevitable result would be local overheating,a sudden drop in performance,or even system crashes.An excellent Manifold ensures that all key components are cooled equally and thoroughly through a precise flow channel design.

The"integrated hub"of the system:It replaces the spider-web-like complex pipes and joints with an integrated design.This not only makes the system structure more compact,but also significantly reduces potential leakage points,enhancing the overall reliability and maintainability.In cabinet-level liquid cooling,the core of that huge coolant distribution unit(CDU)is often a highly complex Manifold.

If design determines the"intelligence quotient"of Manifold,then cleanliness determines its"lifespan".Here,"spotless"is not an adjective but the most fundamental requirement for survival.Any tiny pollutant may trigger a chain reaction disaster.
The Invisible Enemy:The Three Major Hazards of Pollutants
The number one killer:Particulate matter clogging chips

The flow channels inside the cold plate are as thin as hair.A tiny metal chip or welding slag is enough to form a"blood clot",completely blocking the flow path.The consequences are immediate:the corresponding chip area will heat up sharply and eventually burn out due to a"high fever".

The grease or fingerprints left over from the processing are a"feast"for microorganisms(bacteria,algae).They will multiply within the system,forming biofilms that not only block the flow channels but also corrode metals with their metabolic products,causing double damage.

Residual cleaning agents or flux can introduce ionic contamination and increase the conductivity of the coolant.In an electrified environment,this can form an"original battery"between different metal materials,causing electrochemical corrosion and eventually leading to component perforation,coolant leakage,and even short circuits.
How to achieve"surgical grade"cleaning?A micro-war that runs through the entire process
Controlling the cleanliness of Manifold is a systematic project that runs through the entire process of design,manufacturing and assembly.
Design source:From the design of the flow channel,dead corners and complex structures that are difficult to clean are avoided,leaving contaminants"nowhere to hide".
Precision cleaning:Use high-purity deionized water for powerful cleaning.
Drying and sealing:Immediately after cleaning,thoroughly dry with clean hot air or nitrogen,and immediately put"sterile masks"(sealing covers)on all interfaces to isolate external contamination.
Cleanroom assembly:The final assembly must be carried out in a cleanroom,where operators are fully equipped(dust-free suits,gloves,masks),just like performing a precise surgical operation.

Authoritative"physical examination":In accordance with international standards such as ISO 16232,particle counting and ion contamination degree detection are carried out on the cleaned liquid.Data speaks for itself to ensure that each Manifold is"healthy and up to standard".A liquid particle counter and a conductivity meter are needed here.

Details determine success or failure,and purity leads to a distant future.Today,in the pursuit of ultimate computing power and energy efficiency,liquid cooling technology is moving from being"optional"to"essential".And Manifold,this unsung"flow commander",its design and cleanliness level are precisely the key yardstick for measuring the technical depth and professionalism of a liquid cooling supplier.

paragraphs: The cold plate liquid cooling system is composed of a secondary side cooling system,a primary side cooling system,a monitoring system,etc.A system that indirectly transfers the heat of components to the cooling medium enclosed in the circulation pipeline through cold plates,and ultimately discharges the heat of the equipment to the outside through heat exchange and transfer in one or more cooling circuits.

The secondary side cooling system is composed of secondary side cooling medium,cold plate,liquid quick connector,manifold,secondary side pipeline,cooling capacity distribution unit,etc.The primary side cooling system is composed of primary side cooling medium,primary side pipelines,outdoor cold source equipment and supporting equipment,etc.

In cold plate liquid cooling systems,the detection of particle cleanliness is of vital importance,as tiny particle contaminants can clog microchannels(especially in cold plates),wear out the bearings and seals of pumps,reduce heat exchange efficiency,and even cause system failures.
This article mainly introduces the components that need to undergo particle cleanliness testing in the cold plate liquid cooling system.

Reason:This is one of the key components.The microchannels inside the cold plate(especially those used for cooling the CPU/GPU)are very small in diameter(usually only a few tenths of a millimeter).Even very tiny particles(tens of micrometers)can clog these channels,causing local overheating and component failure.
Inspection points:After manufacturing is completed(after welding,brazing,and machining),before assembly,and after the entire system is cleaned.

The reason is that whether it is a water-cooled liquid-water heat exchanger or a water-cooled liquid-air heat exchanger(radiator),the internal flow channels are also relatively narrow(especially for plate heat exchangers).Particles will deposit on the flow channels or fins,reducing heat exchange efficiency and increasing flow resistance.
Inspection points:After manufacturing is completed,before assembly,and after the entire system is cleaned.

Reasons:including quick connectors,flanges,threaded connectors,etc.The grooves,sealing ring installation grooves,threads and other parts inside it are prone to retain processing debris or particles brought in during assembly.These particles will directly enter the main circulation under the scouring of the fluid.
Inspection points:After manufacturing/machining and before assembly(especially in the sealing surface area).

Reason:The inner walls of long straight pipes may retain contaminants from the manufacturing process(such as pipe bending,cutting)or storage.Although large pipe diameters are relatively less prone to clogging,particles will continuously contaminate the fluid and wear out other components.
Inspection points:After manufacturing/cutting/bending the pipe and before assembly(with particular attention to burrs on the cutting end face and internal cleaning).

The reason is that after all components have been cleaned and assembled,flushing the entire circulation loop and testing the particle concentration of the flushing solution is the final step to confirm whether the final cleanliness of the system meets the standards.This can detect contaminants introduced during the assembly process as well as possible"dead zone"residues.
Detection point:After the system assembly is completed and it has been flushed through the prescribed process,and before the working fluid is added.

All components in the cold plate liquid cooling system that come into direct contact with the coolant should be considered for particle cleanliness testing during their manufacturing process and after final assembly into the system,especially those with narrow flow channels,precision moving parts or those prone to contaminant deposition(cold plates,heat exchangers,distributors and collectors,UQD quick couplings).The final flushing fluid cleanliness detection at the system level is the last crucial checkpoint to ensure the reliable operation of the system.Strict cleanliness control is the foundation for ensuring the high performance,long service life and reliability of the liquid cooling system.

Particle counting is a quantitative and highly precise detection method used to determine the size distribution and concentration of solid particles in liquid samples or contaminants extracted from component surfaces.It is a core technology for evaluating the cleanliness of liquid cooling systems.

The working principle of the particle counting method is the light blockage method,which allows the liquid sample to be tested to flow through a very narrow transparent channel illuminated by a light beam.When particles in the liquid flow through,they block the light,causing the intensity of the light received by the sensor to instantly weaken.This change in light intensity is captured by the photoelectric sensor and converted into an electrical pulse signal.The amplitude of the pulse is directly proportional to the projected area of the particles(i.e.,the particle size).The instrument converts the pulse amplitude into the equivalent diameter of the particles(usually based on the diameter of the standard sphere)through calibration.Each pulse signal is counted as one particle.

The particle counting method has the advantages of fast detection speed,high precision,and the ability to simultaneously obtain the number of particles in multiple size channels.It is currently the mainstream method,but its disadvantage is that it cannot distinguish the material and shape of the particles.

The BT8200 liquid particle counter from Babel uses the principle of light blockage for particle detection.It can simultaneously monitor the particle size and quantity in 8 channels.The device is reliable in performance and easy to use,meeting the diverse application needs of users.It is widely used in liquid cooling and heat dissipation,hydraulic systems,parts cleaning,casting machinery,pharmaceuticals,electronics and other industries.

For cold plate liquid cooling systems,the particle counting method is a key quality control measure for evaluating their reliability and lifespan.It precisely quantifies pollutant levels through principles such as the light blocking method,providing indisputable data basis for design,manufacturing and maintenance.Strictly controlling particle contamination is of Paramount importance for ensuring the efficient and stable operation of liquid cooling systems,especially those involving microchannel cold plates.

paragraphs: The application of liquid particle counters in liquid cooling systems is particularly crucial,especially in scenarios with high power density and precise heat dissipation requirements.The liquid cooling system directly or indirectly removes heat through liquid circulation,but particulate contaminants in the liquid may cause blockage,corrosion,reduced heat dissipation efficiency,and even system failure.This article introduces the specific applications and core values of liquid particle counters in liquid cooling systems.

Data center servers use liquid cooling(immersion or cold plate type)instead of traditional air cooling.The coolant(such as deionized water or electronic fluorinated liquid)directly contacts the heat-generating components,achieving high heat dissipation efficiency.However,it has strict requirements for the cleanliness of the liquid.
Micron-sized particles can clog microchannel cold plates or pump valves,leading to a decrease in flow rate and local overheating.
Conductive particles may cause a short circuit in the circuit.
Biological contaminants may breed blockages or corrode pipelines.
The function of a liquid particle counter:
Real-time monitoring:Online detection of particle concentration and size distribution in the coolant(such as≥2µm,≥5µm,≥15µm)to ensure compliance with relevant cleanliness grades.
Preventive maintenance:When the particle concentration exceeds the standard,an alarm is triggered,and the filtration system is linked to automatically purify,avoiding the risk of shutdown.
Enhance the stability of heat dissipation and reduce the risk of downtime in data centers caused by overheating.

High-power semiconductor devices(such as IGBTs)are precisely temperature-controlled through liquid cooling plates.The coolant(deionized water,ethylene glycol)flows through sub-millimeter channels,and even tiny particles can cause blockages.
Ion pollution:If deionized water contains silicon or metal particles,it may reduce insulation and cause electrochemical corrosion.
Fiber contamination:Fibers that have fallen off from the filter element or sealing material get entangled in the flow channel.
Process control:Test the cleanliness of the coolant(deionized water,etc.)before filling to ensure there is no risk of clogging.
Long-term health management:Monitor the trend of particle concentration changes,predict the lifespan of filter elements or the risk of system leakage.
Ensure the heat dissipation performance of high-power devices to prevent overheating and damage.

The Bebur BT8200 liquid particle counter can simultaneously monitor the particle size and corresponding quantity of 8 channels.It adopts the principle of light blockage and can monitor particles with a particle size range of 2-750μm.

The performance of the liquid cooling system is directly related to the cleanliness of the coolant.The liquid particle counter,through real-time monitoring,early warning and closed-loop control,becomes the"gatekeeper"to ensure the reliability of the liquid cooling system.

paragraphs: Behind the speeding electric vehicles and the roaring data centers,there is a key technology that quietly supports the stable operation of these high-heat devices-liquid cooling plates.
However,few people know that even advanced liquid cooling plates can fail due to a micron-sized metal shavings or a dust particle that is invisible to the naked eye.
The liquid particle counter,the"microscope"of the microscopic world,is precisely the ultimate guardian of the cleanliness of the liquid-cooled plate.

The interior of the liquid cooling plate is densely covered with micro-channels thinner than a human hair(about 0.1 to 1 millimeter in width),which transport the coolant like"blood vessels".However,once particulate pollutants are mixed in,the consequences would be unimaginable:
Blockage crisis:If there are too many micron-sized particles,they may directly block the micro-flow channels,leading to local overheating.
Wear down the circulating pump:Sharp particles will wear down the pump body like"sandpaper",shortening the system's lifespan.
Accelerated corrosion:Metal debris undergoes an electrochemical reaction with the coolant,causing perforation and leakage in the flow channel.
The core technology of the BT8200 liquid particle counter is the light obscuration method
Laser penetration:The liquid to be tested flows through a transparent detection cell,and a high-precision laser beam irradiates vertically.
Shadow capture:When particles pass through,they block the light,generating an instantaneous shadow signal.
Intelligent analysis:The sensor converts the particle size based on the shadow area,and the software counts the number of particles of different sizes in real time.
Detection range:Can identify particles ranging from 2 to 750 microns,covering common pollutants.
Channel display:8 particle size channels,customizable particle size detection range(such as 2-5 microns;5-15 microns;15-30 microns;30-50 microns;greater than 50 microns,etc.);
Rapid analysis:Second-level response,capable of quickly detecting the quantity and size of particles in liquids.

Residue detection:After ultrasonic cleaning,use a particle counter to randomly inspect the cleaning solution to ensure that metal shavings and welding slag are thoroughly removed and the cleanliness meets the standards.
Real-time monitoring:The data center detects the concentration of coolant particles in real time to prevent blockage.

Today,as liquid cooling technology advances towards innovation,liquid particle counters have been upgraded from"quality inspection tools"to"system health managers".It reveals the crises of the microscopic world with data and defends the reliability of macroscopic equipment with technology.As an engineer put it,"Every particle detected is a victory over a potential fault."
