paragraphs: Waterworks require that the water leaving the factory contain a certain concentration of disinfectants. The main purpose of adding disinfectants is to kill microorganisms in tap water and water supply pipelines, prevent the spread of water-borne infectious disease bacteria to users, and endanger people's livelihood safety.

According to the "Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water" (GB5749-2022), the routine indicators of drinking water disinfectants include free chlorine, total chlorine, ozone and chlorine dioxide. Common disinfectants include liquid chlorine, sodium hypochlorite, calcium hypochlorite, chloramine, ozone and chlorine dioxide.
When using liquid chlorine, sodium hypochlorite or calcium hypochlorite disinfectants for disinfection, free chlorine should be determined.

The "Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water" (GB5749-2022) stipulates that the standard values for free chlorine are as follows: contact time with water ≥30 minutes, limit values for water leaving the factory and at the end of the pipeline ≤2mg/L, residual amount of water leaving the factory ≥0.3mg/L, and residual amount of water at the end of the pipeline ≥0.05mg/L.
When chloramine disinfectants are used, the total chlorine should be determined.

The "Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water" (GB5749-2022) stipulates that the total chlorine standard value is as follows: contact time with water ≥120 minutes, limit values for water leaving the factory and at the end of the pipeline ≤3mg/L, residual amount of water leaving the factory ≥0.5mg/L, and residual amount of water at the end of the pipeline ≥0.05mg/L.
When ozone disinfectants are used, the ozone level should be measured.

The "Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water" (GB5749-2022) stipulates that the standard values for ozone are as follows: contact time with water ≥12 minutes, limit values for factory water and terminal water ≤0.3mg/L, and residual amount of terminal water ≥0.02mg/L.

When chlorine dioxide disinfectant is used, the chlorine dioxide content should be determined. When using a chlorine dioxide and chlorine mixed disinfectant generator for disinfection, the levels of chlorine dioxide and free chlorine should be determined. Both indicators should meet the limit requirements, and at least one indicator should meet the margin requirements.

The "Hygienic Standard for Drinking Water" (GB5749-2022) stipulates that the standard values of chlorine dioxide are as follows: contact time with water ≥30 minutes, limit values of water leaving the factory and at the end of the pipeline ≤0.8mg/L, residual amount of water leaving the factory ≥0.1mg/L, and residual amount of water at the end of the pipeline ≥0.02mg/L.

The Bebur disinfectant online analyzer adopts the electrochemical measurement principle and can quickly and accurately detect the values of free chlorine (residual chlorine), total chlorine, ozone and chlorine dioxide in water. It features simple operation, accurate measurement and easy maintenance. Users can flexibly configure different sensors on site according to their detection needs. The detection data can be automatically recorded and stored, and can also be downloaded.

title: The application of liquid particle counters in the pharmaceutical industry
headings: The application of liquid particle counters in the pharmaceutical industry
paragraphs: In the pharmaceutical industry, the cleanliness (insoluble particles) of intravenous injection drugs and injection water can be determined through the detection of liquid particle counters, ensuring quality and safety.

Insoluble particles refer to flowable, randomly present tiny particles in intravenous injection drugs that are insoluble in water. Insoluble particles are foreign substances with a particle size generally ranging from 2 to 50μm, which are difficult to be seen by the naked eye. When their particle size exceeds a certain limit or their quantity exceeds a certain limit, they cannot be metabolized in the body and will cause some harm to the human body, such as the formation of granulomas, local tissue embolism and necrosis, phlebitis, tumors or tumor-like reactions. In severe cases, it can even cause allergic reactions and endanger life. Therefore, it is necessary to examine it and strictly control it.
The Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China has clearly stipulated the limit of insoluble particles for intravenous injections:

For intravenous solutions with a labeled volume of 100 ml or more, unless otherwise specified, the number of particles larger than 10μm in each 1mL shall not exceed 25, and the number of particles larger than 25μm shall not exceed 3.

For intravenous solutions with a labeled volume of less than 100mL, sterile powders for intravenous solutions and concentrated solutions for injection, unless otherwise specified, the number of particles larger than 10μm in each test sample container shall not exceed 6,000, and the number of particles larger than 25μm shall not exceed 600.

The Bebur BT8200 liquid particle counter can simultaneously monitor the particle size and corresponding quantity of 8 channels. It adopts the principle of light blockage method and can measure particles with a particle size range of 2-750um. It can detect the particle size and quantity in intravenous injections, ensuring the safety of intravenous medication.

headings: An application example of Bebur water ozone analyzer in the beverage industry
paragraphs: The application history of ozone in drinking water treatment can be traced back to the end of the 19th century. The principle of ozone disinfection is that ozone undergoes a chemical reaction in water, generating highly oxidizing single-atom oxygen (O) and hydroxyl groups (OH), which instantly decompose organic matter, bacteria and microorganisms in water. Hydroxyl groups (OH) are strong oxidants and catalysts that can cause a chain reaction of organic substances, which is very rapid. Hydroxyl groups (OH) have an extremely strong killing effect on various pathogenic microorganisms. Single-atom oxygen (O) also has strong oxidizing power and is highly lethal to tenacious microorganisms such as bacteria and spores.

As a strong oxidant, ozone has a powerful oxidation capacity, is broad-spectrum and highly efficient. It can quickly kill amoebas, fungi, protozoa and some pathogenic organisms that are resistant to chlorine, ultraviolet rays and antibiotics. Moreover, it has a better purification function for water quality, can remove excessive iron and manganese content in water, and remove organic matter under the action of ozone and activated carbon, eliminating odors in water. At the same time, the oxygen content in the water increases, making the water clearer and more transparent. It is widely used in water treatment, the food industry, beverage processing, aquaculture, waterworks and other fields.

The Bebur water ozone analyzer uses electrochemical principles to monitor the ozone content in water. The sensor adopts a membrane device, which is not affected by PH value changes. It does not use reagents and has stable performance, which can reduce maintenance and save users' usage costs. In the beverage industry, the Bebur water ozone analyzer is mainly used for the measurement and control of ozone sterilization and disinfection in production water.

title: The Application of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in the Dosing Process of Power Plant Water Treatment
headings: The Application of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in the Dosing Process of Power Plant Water Treatment
Ii.Why is it indispensable in power plant water treatment?
Iii.How does it work?--Intelligent Coagulation"Autonomous Driving"
Iv.What huge benefits has it brought to power plants?
An application example of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in a power plant in Jiangsu Province
paragraphs: In the energy heart of a power plant,water is the lifeline that sustains its vigorous pulsation.From the cooling cycle to the boiler steam,every drop of water needs to undergo precise treatment.In the first checkpoint of water treatment-the pretreatment stage,a"black technology"called Streaming Current Detectors(SCD)is quietly revolutionizing the traditional dosing mode and becoming the intelligent brain for power plants to save water,reduce consumption,improve quality and increase efficiency.
Simply speaking,Streaming Current Detectors are like a highly sensitive"charge detective".It can detect in real time the charge intensity carried by tiny colloidal particles in water.

Its core is a detection cell with a piston.When the water sample flows through,the piston reciprocates,pushing the charged particles in the water,thereby generating a weak current signal.The instrument captures and amplifies this signal and converts it into a definite reading(SC value).
It directly reflects the core principle of coagulation treatment-the effect of electro-neutralization.

The water treatment system of power plants is large and complex.Its primary task is to convert the raw water in rivers,lakes and lakes into clear and clear water.If the pretreatment effect is poor,suspended solids and colloids will quickly contaminate and clog the subsequent expensive reverse osmosis membranes and ion exchange resins,leading to a decline in water production efficiency,frequent cleaning,and a sharp increase in operating costs.

Traditional coagulation dosing relies on the experience of experienced workers or manual adjustment based on the turbidity of the raw water,which has serious lag and blindness.When water quality fluctuates,either insufficient dosing leads to substandard effluent or excessive dosing causes waste and an increase in sludge volume.
The emergence of Streaming Current Detectors has completely changed this situation.It transforms the coagulation process from"experience-driven"to"data-driven"automatic control.
Imagine the autonomous driving function of cars.Streaming Current Detectors are the"autonomous driving system"for water treatment.
Set the goal:The engineer sets a benchmark value(determined based on the beaker test).
Real-time monitoring:The instrument continuously monitors the charge of the water sample after treatment with coagulant.

Automatic decision-making:When the turbidity of the raw water or the concentration of colloids changes and the flow Current deviates from the set value,the SCM530Streaming Current Detectors automatically adjust the frequency of the dosing pump,increase or decrease the dosage of the reagent,and bring the flow current back to the target range.

Repetitive cycle:This process occurs every second,forming a dynamic and real-time closed-loop control system.No matter how the quality of the raw water fluctuates,the system can automatically stabilize the coagulation state at the optimal point.

1.Stable water output,safeguarding core equipment:It can ensure that the turbidity of the pre-treated water remains consistently at a low level(such as<1NTU),protecting the downstream reverse osmosis membranes and ion exchange resins from the source,extending their lifespan by over 30%,and significantly reducing the frequency of cleaning and downtime.

2.Precise dosing,significantly reducing drug consumption:Say goodbye to"extensive"dosing and precisely apply drugs based on actual needs.According to statistics,the dosage of coagulant can generally be saved by 15%to 30%,and the economic benefits are extremely significant.

3.Reduce sludge and lower disposal costs:With the reduction in the dosage of chemicals,the amount of chemical sludge produced naturally decreases,saving sludge treatment costs and making the environment more environmentally friendly.

4.Full automation,liberating labor:It has achieved 7x24-hour unattended automatic operation,reducing the reliance on the experience of operators and enhancing the overall automation level of the power plant.

In the era of intelligent and refined operation,small devices like Streaming Current Detectors are precisely the great assistants for power plants to enhance water treatment efficiency and achieve the goals of energy conservation and carbon reduction.Although it is hidden beside the pipeline,it quietly plays a crucial role like a"brain",safeguarding the water supply lifeline of the power plant and creating visible economic and environmental benefits for the enterprise.

title: An application example of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in a power plant in Jiangsu Province
headings: An application example of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in a power plant in Jiangsu Province
Ii.Working Principle of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors
Iii.Specific Application Schemes in Power Plants
Iv.Value and Benefits Brought by Application
The Application of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in the Dosing Process of Power Plant Water Treatment
paragraphs: In thermal power plants,preparing qualified water is the"lifeline"to ensure the safe and stable operation of the units.As the first crucial checkpoint in water treatment,the"coagulation-clarification"system directly determines the burden on subsequent systems and the overall water production cost.
For a long time,how to precisely add coagulants has been a common pain point for water treatment personnel in thermal power plants.

SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors,as a high-precision online colloid charge monitoring instrument,play a crucial role in the water treatment system of power plants,especially in the key link of coagulation-clarification.
This article mainly introduces the application scenarios,solved problems,realized values and key points of application of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in a power plant in Jiangsu Province.

The raw water of a certain power plant in Jiangsu Province is usually taken from the Yangtze River or surrounding rivers.The water quality varies significantly with the seasons,tides,rainfall and upstream activities.Before the application of SCM530,power plants mainly faced the following challenges in the coagulation treatment process:

The dosage of coagulant relies on manual experience:Operators usually adjust the dosage based on the data from the turbidity meter and the formation of"flocs"observed by the naked eye.This method is highly lagging and inaccurate,and cannot respond in real time to rapid changes in water quality.

Excessive dosing:leads to waste of chemicals and increases operating costs;Residual aluminium or iron salts may cause contamination or poisoning to subsequent ion exchange resins and reverse osmosis membranes.

Insufficient dosing:Poor coagulation effect,high effluent turbidity,colloidal particles will penetrate the clarifier and filter,and also contaminate the subsequent fine treatment system,shortening the service life of filter materials and membranes.

Slow response when water quality fluctuates:When the raw water quality suddenly changes(such as an increase in turbidity and organic matter content after a heavy rain),manual adjustments often fail to keep up with the speed of change,resulting in prolonged water quality non-compliance.
To understand its application,one must first grasp its principle:

Streaming Current Detectors detect the surface charges of colloidal particles in water.Colloidal particles in water usually carry a negative charge.The function of coagulants(such as polyaluminium,ferric chloride,etc.)is to compress the double electric layer through electro-neutralization,thereby destabilizing the colloids.The SCM530 moves back and forth in the sampled water through a piston,generating an alternating current.The intensity of this current directly reflects the charge level(i.e.,the SC value)of the colloidal particles in the water.
The SCM530 converts this SC value into a standard signal(such as 4-20mA)and transmits it to the PLC or DCS system,thereby achieving closed-loop automatic control of coagulant dosing.
In the application of this power plant,the typical installation and control logic is as follows:

Installation point:SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors are usually installed at the inlet or the end of the reaction zone of the mechanically accelerated clarifiers or flocculation sedimentation tanks.The water sample at this point has undergone chemical mixing and initial reaction,and can truly reflect the coagulation effect.
Control system integration:SCM530 serves as a"detector"to monitor the SC value in real time.The PLC/DCS acts as the"brain",receiving the SC value signal.

Control strategy:The system sets a target set point with an SC value.The PLC compares the real-time SC value with the set point and,through the PID algorithm,outputs control signals to the coagulant dosing pump(usually a metering pump)to automatically adjust the stroke or frequency of the dosing pump.

Closed-loop control process:Changes in raw water quality→SC value deviates from the set point→PLC calculates the deviation→Output instructions adjust the dosing pump→SC value returns to the set point→Achieve stable and optimized coagulation effect.
After the SCM530 was put into use in this power plant in Jiangsu,remarkable economic and technical benefits were achieved:

Significantly reduce chemical costs:Through precise control,the waste of chemicals is avoided,and"on-demand dosing"is achieved.It can usually save 10%to 25%of the consumption of coagulants,directly reducing the cost of water treatment.

Stabilize and improve the effluent quality:The effluent turbidity is more stable,reducing the load on subsequent filters and membrane treatment systems,decreasing the frequency of backwashing and chemical cleaning,and extending the service life of deep treatment equipment.

Realize fully automatic control and reduce manual intervention:It greatly reduces the labor intensity of the operators,eliminates the possibility of human misjudgment,and the system can operate stably even at night or on holidays.

Rapid response to water quality fluctuations:When the raw water quality undergoes sudden changes,the SCM530 can detect the change within tens of seconds and activate the adjustment program.The system's response speed is much faster than that of manual operation,effectively preventing prolonged water quality deterioration.

Reducing sludge production:Precise dosing means that less metal hydroxide precipitates are introduced into the system,thereby reducing the sludge discharge from the clarifier,as well as lowering the cost of sludge treatment and the environmental burden.
In the successful application of this power plant in Jiangsu,some important experiences have also been accumulated:

Representative sampling:It is essential to ensure that the water sample flowing to the SCM530 sensor is representative and that the flow rate and pressure are stable.Appropriate sampling pumps and flow stabilizing devices need to be configured.
Regular maintenance and calibration:The sensor probe needs to be cleaned regularly to prevent contaminants from adhering.

Optimization of set points:The set points of SC are not fixed and need to be fine-tuned according to seasonal changes and long-term operation data.Usually,a series of"beaker tests"need to be conducted in the early stage of operation to assist in determination.

All in all,the successful application of SCM530 Streaming Current Detectors in a power plant in Jiangsu Province is a typical example of the transformation and upgrading of water treatment process control from"experience-driven"to"data-driven".By real-time monitoring of colloidal charge,an essential parameter of the coagulation process,it realizes the closed-loop automatic control of coagulant dosing,ultimately achieving the comprehensive goals of energy conservation and consumption reduction,stable operation,water quality improvement,and staff reduction and efficiency increase,providing a strong guarantee for the safe,economic and stable operation of power plants.
